summary: Wallowa County, OR lookout site: 16x16 ft log cabin on an 18 ft platform built 1934; named lookouts to 1967; abandoned 1959 or the 1960s; now gone.

facts.design: 16x16 ft log cabin on an 18 ft platform (1934)
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Wallowa-Whitman National Forest
facts.status_note: Abandoned and gone per the register; Forest Lookouts marks it removed. No source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: 16x16 ft log cabin with an 18 ft platform constructed on the site
Lawrence Potter listed for 1936 and 1941; first name in the Firelookout.com personnel list
Kerry Searles listed for 1967, the last name in the Firelookout.com personnel list
Registered November 20, 2019; nominated by Tammy McLeod

evidence.supports: former lookout site (Mormon Mountain (G.S.) Lookout Site)
1934 16x16 ft log cabin with 18 ft platform built on the site
evidence.quote: In 1934 a 16X16 foot log cabin was constructed on the site along with a 18 foot platform.

evidence.supports: 1934 16x16 ft log cabin and 18 ft platform
named lookouts from 1936 (Lawrence Potter) through 1967 (Kerry Searles), including Alva Keeler, Phillip Truman, David Reed and Jesse Earl
evidence.quote: Known lookout personnel: 1936, 1941: Lawrence Potter; 1942: Alva Keeler & Phillip Truman; 1943: Alva Keeler & David Reed; 1949-1951, 1955-1956, 1962: Jesse Earl; 1967: Kerry Searles

evidence.supports: register gives abandonment in 1959 and says it is gone
evidence.quote: The lookout was abandoned in 1959 and is gone.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts marks the site as removed

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on abandonment: the register says 1959; Firelookout.com says 'Abandoned 1960s' and lists named lookouts through 1967. Not resolved by the sources read. Forest Lookouts gives 'Removed' with no date. Record kind 'platform' matches the cabin-on-platform description. Access and current remains are unknown; no source read describes them. Web search budget ran out before a Forest Service or history source on removal was found.
